about: The Bachelor of Business Administration at City College of Management is a three-year undergraduate degree affiliated to the University of Lucknow. It builds a foundation in management, covering principles of management, marketing, finance, human resources, accounting, business law, economics and entrepreneurship.

Teaching combines classroom lectures with case studies, presentations, group projects and industry visits, so students learn how businesses actually run. The programme suits students from any 10+2 stream who want a career in business or plan to go on to an MBA.

h1: B.Ed (Bachelor of Education) College in Lucknow
summary: A two-year NCTE-recognised teacher-education programme with a structured school internship.
about: The Bachelor of Education is a two-year professional programme recognised by the National Council for Teacher Education. It prepares graduates to teach at upper primary, secondary and senior secondary levels. The course covers childhood and growing up, learning and teaching, pedagogy of school subjects, assessment, inclusive education, and information and communication technology in education.
A major part of the programme is school internship. Trainees observe and teach real classes in partner schools under the guidance of college faculty and school mentors.
